content: Twinrix is a vaccine designed to provide protection against both hepatitis A and hepatitis B. It is administered in a series of three doses. The name Twinrix was derived from the fact that it combines two previously existing vaccines: Havrix, which is an inactivated-virus vaccine for hepatitis A, and Engerix-B, which is a recombinant vaccine for hepatitis B. According to GlaxoSmithKline, the manufacturer of Twinrix, their studies indicate that 70% of individuals who received the vaccine developed antibodies against hepatitis B as early as one month after receiving just the first dose. It is important to note that Twinrix, Havrix, and Engerix-B are registered trademarks of GlaxoSmithKline. If a similar vaccine is produced by another company, it will be marketed under a different name.
